questions.stem: Neither the teacher nor the students ___ present.
questions.explanation: With neither...nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject, and 'students' is plural.

questions.stem: Each of the boys ___ a textbook.

questions.explanation: 'Since 2015' marks an action that began in the past and continues now, so the present perfect 'has lived' is needed.

questions.stem: Yesterday, we ___ a film at the cinema.
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' is a finished past time, so the simple past 'watched' is needed.
The h in 'honest' is silent, so the word begins with a vowel sound and takes 'an'.

questions.stem: The manager was [[furious]] when he saw the damage. Choose the option nearest in meaning to the underlined word.
The road to the village is very [[narrow]]. Choose the option opposite in meaning to the underlined word.
questions.explanation: 'Narrow' means small from side to side; its opposite is 'wide'.

questions.stem: Choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the one in [[food]].
questions.explanation: food and blue have /uː/; good and foot have /ʊ/, and flood has /ʌ/.

questions.stem: I am [[looking forward to see]] you. Choose the option that best replaces the underlined part.
questions.explanation: In 'look forward to', 'to' is a preposition, so it is followed by the -ing form: looking forward to seeing.
